request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open, standardized API/interface layer for Cardano dApp protocols with developer and AI-agent-facing infrastructure.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide an open, standardized interface that lets developers and AI agents discover, integrate, and compose Cardano on-chain protocols through a single consistent surface.
The proposal states that Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across the ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and rebuild understanding independently.
The proposal says Tx3 describes each protocol once with a verified interface definition and produces documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from that definition.
The proposal states that Catalyst Fund 14 already put the Tx3 developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry at tx3.land.
The proposal identifies Strike Finance, Indigo Protocol, VyFinance, Bodega Market, and Fluid Tokens as protocols already accessible through Tx3.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not, at time of submission, on its own or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The proposal says TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

The proposal states that funds will be administered through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and a Project-Specific Smart Contract with multi-party authorization, oversight entities, milestone metadata, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document describes a 1,684,050 ADA treasury withdrawal submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe to expand Tx3 over 12 months, emphasizing open protocol interfaces, AI-agent integration, additional protocol onboarding, and Intersect-administered smart-contract oversight.
